description: Cross-stack output contract for AI-CodeGuard. The TypeScript reporter (src/reporter/sarif.ts) and the Python exporter (src/ai_code_audit/output/sarif.py) both emit SARIF that is uploaded to the same GitHub Code Scanning instance, so the fields below must agree. Conformance is enforced from both sides: tests/unit/sarif-contract.test.ts and tests/test_sarif_contract.py each read this file and assert their own implementation matches it. Change a value here and both suites fail until both stacks are updated.

python.description: Phase-2 taint, dataflow and heuristic rules. The 004- prefix is this product's id in the shared-integration finding namespace.

notes.severityVocabulary: info is Python-only; the TypeScript Severity union has no such member. Both stacks must map any severity they do emit through severityLevels.
notes.partialFingerprints: Emitted by the TypeScript reporter only. The key is fixed here so that if the Python exporter gains fingerprints they land under the same key rather than a second one.
notes.driverVersion: Deliberately absent. The npm package (ai-codeguard) and the Python package (ai-codeguard-upgrade) are separately named distributables and version independently; each stack reports its own.
